meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 你给出要深入看的代码位置后,Claude 会先在项目的知识图谱中定位该组件,查出它调用/依赖谁、谁调用它、属于哪个架构层,再读源码,用通俗方式讲解它的作用、内部结构、数据流向和值得注意的写法。
howto.when: 当你要求深入解释代码库中某个具体文件、函数或模块时触发(例如给出文件路径);前提是项目已有知识图谱,否则 Claude 会先提示你运行 /understand。

say.text: 帮我深入解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件。
say.note: Claude 会定位该文件并讲解它的上下文。

say.text: 订单模块在整体架构里属于哪一层?哪些地方在用它?
say.note: 会说明模块层级与调用方。

howto.what_en: Given a code location, Claude finds it in the project's knowledge graph, follows its dependencies and callers, finds its layer, reads the source, and explains role, internals, data flow, and notable patterns simply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a deep-dive on a specific file, function, or module, e.g. by giving a path. Requires an existing knowledge graph; otherwise Claude tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.note: Claude locates the file and explains its context.

say_en.text: What does checkToken in src/service.ts do, and what is it connected to?
say_en.note: Explains the function's purpose and its dependencies.

say_en.text: Which architecture layer does the order module belong to, and who uses it?
say_en.note: Explains the module's layer and callers.
